compliance_decision:
Compliance Answer: Customer records should be retained for at least five years from the date of transaction conclusion or report submission, as applicable.
Relevant Regulatory Basis: Section 22A and section 29 of the FIC Act (as per Revised-Guidance-Note-7A).
Explanation: The regulatory text specifies that records related to transactions concluded under section 22A must be kept for a minimum period of five years from when those transactions are completed. Similarly, transactional or activity records leading to reports as mentioned in section 29 should also be retained for the same duration after report submission.
